ld.articleBody:
The Superhero Landscape and Invincible's Place

Quality superhero programming has expanded far beyond traditional Marvel and DC cinematic universes, with various streaming platforms and anime studios offering formidable alternatives. Shows like The Umbrella Academy provided Netflix with strong viewership, while anime entries such as One Punch Man and My Hero Academia captured massive audiences globally.

Despite robust competition across the television landscape, Prime Video houses some of the most celebrated non-Marvel or DC superhero series of the past decade. Projects like The Tick and The Boys carved out distinct identities, yet the animated adaptation of Invincible consistently stands out as a true gem due to its intricate storytelling and memorable roster.

A Mature, Expanding Narrative Scope

At the core of the Prime Video series is a mature and emotional foundation that explores the trials of Mark Grayson alongside the overarching Viltrumite conflict. The narrative avoids stagnation by frequently spotlighting compelling secondary villains and supporting heroes, giving the fictional universe a vast and growing scope.

Being a faithful adaptation of the source material allows the project to maintain a gritty tone, though the creative team is never afraid to introduce thoughtful narrative modifications. This balance keeps the pacing brisk and ensures that even when the plot shifts away from the primary characters, the viewing experience remains engaging.

Analyzing the Controversial Hell Episode

Among the extensive episode list, the fourth season featured a notable installment titled Hurm, commonly referred to as the Hell episode, which deviated entirely from the original comic books. This storyline drew harsh criticism from portions of the fanbase, earning a reputation as the lowest-rated entry in an otherwise critically acclaimed run.

Despite generating a divisive reaction among viewers, examining the chapter in isolation reveals a competent piece of television that easily holds its own against rival superhero programs. The story brought back Damien Darkblood, a fan-favorite character from the first season, while serving as a pivotal emotional turning point for the protagonist.

Lore Expansion and Character Development

Venturing into the underworld granted Mark a fresh perspective on his heroism, proving that his chaotic journey contained deeper underlying purpose. Furthermore, the episode explained critical lore regarding the origin of monsters and the distinct historical eras within the fictional universe.

Before the action escalated, the opening phase featured a memorable heart-to-heart conversation between Mark and Art that grounded the episode emotionally. Written by series creator Robert Kirkman, the outing was far from arbitrary filler and contributed directly to the broader mythology.

Ratings Context and Fan Expectations

Following review bombing campaigns, the divisive installment secured an IMDb rating of 6.5, matching the weakest outings of celebrated classics like Batman: The Animated Series and outperforming the lowest-rated episodes of Teen Titans. This metric demonstrates that the hate directed at the chapter was largely disproportionate to its actual quality.

The intense scrutiny faced by the episode largely stems from the exceptionally high standards that audiences have come to expect from the series. Rather than indicating a permanent drop in quality, the strong reaction highlights how deeply invested the fanbase is in the overarching narrative trajectory.

Future Prospects for Season 5 and Beyond

With the series slated to return for a fifth season in 2027 and a confirmed sixth season renewal, creators have a clear opportunity to continue the underworld narrative thread. Although Mark defeated Volcanikka temporarily, her immortal nature ensures that the threat remains unresolved.

The narrative cliffhanger involving Damien Darkblood being sent by Satan to investigate human activity provides ample justification to revisit the storyline. Blending these supernatural elements with concurrent plots in future episodes could help win over skeptics who disliked the standalone format.

Prime Video's animated superhero series Invincible continues to garner attention for its high overall quality, even amidst fan debate over its fourth-season Hell episode. Despite facing criticism and lower ratings for straying from the source material, the controversial installment expanded vital series lore and paved the way for future storylines in upcoming seasons.

ld.articleBody:
A Wild Group Therapy Session on the Couch

Karan Johar returned with another explosive instalment of his celebrity chat show, turning a casual mid-week conversation into an unfiltered group therapy session. Episode 6 of Koffee With Karan Season 9 brought together actress Ananya Panday alongside businesswoman Ananya Birla, while childhood friend Shanaya Kapoor later walked in as a surprise wildcard entry for the rapid-fire round.

The trio held absolutely nothing back, dishing out dating confessions, billionaire secrets, and poking fun at nepotism and delayed cinematic debuts. Viewers were treated to candid revelations from the start, as the guests navigated the host's sharp probing with total ease and ample humor.

Dating Confessions and Marriage Hopes

Host Karan Johar wasted no time teasing Ananya Panday about her reputation for moving on quickly from past heartbreaks. Addressing the chatter surrounding her love life head-on, the actress offered an unapologetic perspective on romance and her ultimate relationship goals.

She confessed openly that she has experienced a few relationships, emphasizing that there is nothing inherently wrong with that reality. Expressing her deep-rooted belief in lifelong partnership, she noted that she feels she was born to get married, loves the concept of marriage, and looks forward to spending her life with one person. She added that if a dynamic fails to work or leaves individuals unhappy, everyone has the right to walk away.

The Record-Breaking Phone Call Segment

One of the standout moments arrived during the signature game segment when Panday was challenged to dial up former flames. Displaying impressive speed-dial luck, she reached out to Aditya Roy Kapur—who happened to be admitted to a hospital recovering from dengue—followed by Ishaan Khatter and a video call to Kartik Aaryan.

Remarkably, every single person answered the phone. Ananya Birla immediately teased her co-guest about contacting all her exes in one go, prompting Panday to laughingly declare herself a record breaker.

Billionaire Secrets From Ananya Birla

Businesswoman Ananya Birla shared plenty of intriguing stories of her own during the episode. She dropped fascinating insights into her high-profile lifestyle, revealing that she never carries physical cash and once went to the extent of getting an entire venue cleared purely for a private date night.

Beyond luxury anecdotes, Birla also opened up about her personal and professional struggles. She discussed rejecting a major marriage proposal multiple times while simultaneously navigating boardroom sexism and breaking barriers as a prominent entrepreneur.

Shanaya Kapoor Joins as Wildcard

The energy shifted when Shanaya Kapoor made her surprise entry onto the couch, injecting a fresh wave of hilarity and warmth. She addressed the endless chatter surrounding her cinematic journey with absolute grace, laughing off the rudest troll comment she had ever encountered regarding her long-awaited launch.

Making fun of the delay, she quoted a troll who remarked that she beat her father, Sanjay Kapoor, to the longest delayed debut. She also shared humorous anecdotes about her father endlessly talking about ice whenever she introduces him to potential suitors.

Shared Crushes and Lighthearted Banter

As the conversation flowed freely, the friendship between Panday and Kapoor was on full display. Both stars lightheartedly admitted to harboring a massive celebrity crush on Ranveer Singh.

Meanwhile, Panday poked fun at her fellow guest sharing her first name, jokingly remarking that she dislikes every other Ananya except Birla, capping off an episode filled with non-stop entertainment and playful banter.

ld.articleBody:
Dedication to an Epic Scale

Oscar-winning music director AR Rahman recently shared details about his extensive creative journey while working on the soundtrack for the mythological epic Ramayana. Speaking at the International Film Festival of India, the celebrated composer explained how deeply he immersed himself in the project, which required a significant investment of his time and focus.

The sheer magnitude of the production meant that conventional timelines did not apply. Rahman noted that the rigorous development period allowed him and his team to refine the musical themes thoroughly, ensuring they matched the grandiose vision of the cinematic duology.

Turning Down Major Filmmakers

To maintain complete creative immersion in the project, Rahman made the deliberate choice to step away from several other lucrative opportunities. He revealed that he declined ten to twelve different film projects offered by prominent directors in order to remain entirely within the appropriate artistic zone.

Reflecting on these decisions, the composer expressed a sense of pride in prioritizing quality over quantity. He emphasized that he only accepts assignments that genuinely stimulate his artistic sensibility and excite his entire creative team.

Collaborations and Iterative Process

The composition process for Ramayana involved extensive revisions and a partnership with fellow legendary composer Hans Zimmer. Rahman highlighted the meticulous nature of their work, pointing out that certain tracks underwent dozens of experimental iterations before achieving the desired impact.

As an example, he mentioned that the piece titled Ravana Tandav went through twelve to thirteen distinct versions before the creators finally settled on the arrangement that satisfied everyone involved in the production.

Soundtrack Components and Notable Tracks

The soundtrack for Ramayana: Part 1 features a diverse array of tracks and vocal talents. Songs such as Jai Jai Ram include vocals by Arijit Singh and Shreya Ghoshal, while Ravana Tandav showcases the singing of Vishal Dadlani. Additionally, Sita's Aspiration features contributions from artists including A.R. Ameen, Vaishali Samant, Rakshita Suresh, and Antra Nandy, with all lyrics written by poet Kumar Vishwas.

Beyond these vocal numbers, the album incorporates an orchestral version of Jai Jai Ram and a dedicated Rama Theme that was jointly crafted by Rahman and Zimmer.

Critical Reception and Public Debate

Despite the high anticipation surrounding the collaboration between two world-renowned composers, the music of Ramayana has encountered its share of critique from listeners. Certain tracks sparked considerable debate on social media platforms shortly after their public release.

Specifically, questions were raised regarding whether the compositions fully matched public expectations for the ambitious project. Ravana Tandav faced scrutiny from some users who felt it lacked traditional intensity, while another track named Mangal Rang drew discussion over its distinct qawwali elements.

Production Background and Cast

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra alongside Yash, the mythological film is mounted on a massive budget reported at four thousand crore rupees. The high-profile cast features Ranbir Kapoor portraying Lord Rama, Yash as Ravana, Sai Pallavi as Sita, and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman.

The first installment of the epic has enjoyed a strong commercial run, achieving significant box office milestones with over nine hundred and twenty crore rupees net domestically and nearly seventeen hundred crore rupees gross worldwide.

The extensive creative process involved numerous revisions for tracks like Ravana Tandav, which accompanied the film's massive box office run and generated widespread public discussion.

ld.articleBody:
Second Day Theatrical Performance

The theatrical run of the action thriller O.M: Operation Mole encountered a modest cooling off period on its second day at the box office. Featuring a high-profile ensemble cast, the movie pulled in Rs 15.40 crore in net domestic earnings across India on Saturday, November 21. Exhibited across 6,488 shows in three distinct languages, the feature experienced a 14.9 percent contraction compared to its opening day collection of Rs 18.10 crore.

This latest single-day intake elevates the movie's cumulative domestic net total to Rs 33.50 crore. Meanwhile, the domestic gross has advanced to Rs 38.90 crore. Bolstered by international ticket sales, the cumulative worldwide gross for the first two days has scaled up to Rs 60.90 crore.

Language-Wise Contribution and Show Counts

Distributed in Tamil, Telugu, and Hindi, the project saw varying levels of traction across regions. The Tamil version served as the primary revenue engine, pulling in Rs 11.40 crore from 3,768 shows. The Telugu edition secured Rs 3.50 crore across 1,645 screenings, whereas the Hindi translation generated Rs 50 lakh through 1,075 shows.

Altogether, the production maintained a total of 13,116 shows over the opening two days. On Saturday, the release registered an average collection of Rs 23,736 per show, accompanied by an overall national occupancy rate of 42.3 percent, slipping slightly from the 45.6 percent recorded on opening day.

Detailed Occupancy Rates Across Versions

Audience turnout varied notably depending on the language track and time of day. The Tamil 2D version led regional metrics with an overall occupancy of 53.35 percent, peaking during night shows at 71.77 percent. Morning, afternoon, and evening screenings for the Tamil version recorded 31.92 percent, 53.38 percent, and 56.31 percent respectively.

The Telugu 2D version achieved an overall occupancy of 44.14 percent, scaling from 21.64 percent in the morning to 62.55 percent by night. Conversely, the Hindi 2D version reported a more modest 18.38 percent overall occupancy, registering 10.20 percent in the morning and climbing to a peak of 24.30 percent during night shows.

Regional Dominance in Domestic Gross

Within the domestic market, Tamil Nadu emerged as the single largest contributor to the day-two gross figures. The state yielded Rs 7.75 crore, representing 43.3 percent of the day's total India gross. The neighboring states of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana jointly contributed Rs 4.25 crore, claiming a 23.7 percent share.

Further contributions came from Kerala, which added Rs 3.15 crore, and Karnataka, which chipped in with Rs 1.90 crore. Remaining territories across India collectively accounted for the final portion of the domestic gross with Rs 85 lakh.

Overseas Market Performance

International territories continued to bolster the overall financial standing of the feature. On Saturday alone, the movie added Rs 10 crore in overseas gross collections. This international surge brought the cumulative overseas gross total to Rs 22 crore.

Combined with domestic figures, the overseas earnings proved vital in pushing the worldwide gross past the sixty-crore threshold. Tamil language collections specifically accounted for 74.6 percent of domestic earnings, followed by Telugu at 22.7 percent and Hindi at 2.7 percent.

Comparison with Amaran

In terms of box office trajectory, O.M: Operation Mole currently tracks behind director Rajkumar Periasamy's previous venture, Amaran. The 2024 film pulled in a higher second-day net collection of Rs 19.15 crore in India, alongside a domestic gross of Rs 22.16 crore after a milder 10.5 percent drop from its opening day.

Furthermore, Amaran had amassed a worldwide gross of Rs 68.90 crore by the end of its second day, supported by 4,551 shows and an average occupancy of 68.3 percent, outpacing the current metrics of the Dhanush and Sai Pallavi starrer.

O.M: Operation Mole recorded Rs 15.40 crore in India net collections on its second day, bringing its worldwide gross to Rs 60.90 crore. The multilingual action thriller continues to trail behind the director's previous release, Amaran, while maintaining strong regional contributions primarily led by Tamil Nadu.

ld.articleBody:
The Television Return

Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes recently made their joint return to television, appearing together as contestants on a November episode of Name That Tune. The couple stepped into the game show spotlight to face off against one another in a friendly competition for charitable causes.

During the episode, T.J. played to raise funds for the Chloe and Maude Foundation, while Amy competed to support the Under 40 Foundation. Both participants brought equal energy to the stage as they navigated the musical challenges.

On-Screen Gameplay and Romantic Moments

The pair went head-to-head during the Big-a-Note round, where contestants are tasked with identifying popular wedding songs. At that point in the game, both players were tied with three thousand dollars each.

Interestingly, neither Amy nor T.J. managed to recognize the popular Ed Sheeran track Thinking Out Loud, leaving the question unanswered. However, once Robin Thicke performed the full version of the song, T.J. pulled his wife close for a tender dance on stage, prompting host Jane Krakowski to remark that romance was clearly in the air.

Background on Their Departure From GMA3

Before this television appearance, the duo was widely known for anchoring GMA3 together alongside their former co-star Dr. Jennifer Ashton starting in 2020. Amy had built a long tenure with ABC News beginning in 2012, while T.J. joined the network in 2014.

Their time at the network came to an end in January 2023. At that time, People released a statement from an ABC spokesman explaining that after productive conversations regarding various options, all parties mutually agreed it was best for Amy and T.J. to move on from ABC News while acknowledging their past contributions and talent.

Relationship Timeline and Private Marriage

The public first became aware of the couple's romance when paparazzi photographed them embracing while both were still married to their previous partners, though it was not yet public knowledge that they had already separated from those spouses.

After navigating considerable public attention following their departure from morning television, the couple celebrated a private wedding in Arkansas on September 19, 2026.

Speculation Surrounding Future Projects

Speculation about a potential return to regular broadcasting intensified following rumors that CBS executives were considering bringing the duo back to host a brand-new morning show.

When asked about the possibility of returning to a network during an exclusive chat with HELLO! at iHeartRadio KIIS FM's Jingle Ball at the Intuit Dome, T.J. offered a brief and intriguing response by simply saying, "Per chance."

Timing Coinciding With Exes' Wedding

This television comeback occurred shortly after their respective former spouses held their own wedding ceremony on November 1. Marilee Fiebig and Andrew Shue exchanged vows at a farm in New Jersey.

Andrew was previously married to Amy, while Marilee was previously married to T.J., with both of those prior divorces having been finalized in 2023. Andrew had announced in October that he and Marilee quietly became engaged earlier in the spring following a relationship that initially became public in December 2023.

News Overview

Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes appeared together as contestants on Name That Tune, marking their television return following their departure from GMA3 in 2023. Their appearance on the game show took place shortly after their respective former spouses, Marilee Fiebig and Andrew Shue, got married in November.

The Return of All's Fair

The popular legal drama series is officially making its comeback on Hulu this week for its second season. Despite receiving negative reviews during its initial run, the program managed to secure its place as the largest scripted premiere on the streaming platform within a three-year span.

The narrative follows the brilliant attorneys at the firm Grant, Ronson Greene as they navigate intense breakups, high-profile scandals, and intricate courtroom battles where wealth dictates the rules.

Season Two Plot and Conflicts

As the legal team steps back into the spotlight for the second installment, audiences can expect more dramatic secrets and high-stakes tension. Friendships will undergo severe stress while new alliances emerge among the staff.

A surprising revelation poses a direct threat to the survival of the firm itself, forcing the characters to adapt quickly to changing circumstances both inside and outside the courtroom.

Release Schedule and Streaming Details

Fans eager to watch the new episodes can tune in starting November 4th at midnight ET or 9 pm PT. The platform will drop the first three episodes simultaneously.

Following the initial premiere, subsequent episodes will become available on a weekly basis every Wednesday on Hulu as well as Disney+ for subscribers who have the bundle.

Returning Cast Members

The upcoming season brings back a large portion of the original ensemble to reprise their roles at the firm. Exactly seven core stars have been confirmed to return for the new episodes.

These familiar faces will continue to anchor the legal drama as the narrative delves deeper into their personal and professional lives.

New Series Regular and Guest Stars

In addition to the returning performers, the production has added a brand new series regular to the main lineup for the second season.

The ensemble is also expanding significantly with the introduction of seventeen new guest stars, which notably includes drag queens from RuPaul's Drag Race.

The legal drama established itself as a major viewing event on Hulu despite the critical reception it faced upon launch. The combination of high-fashion elements and legal maneuvering struck a chord with streaming audiences.

The show centers on a world where emotional bonds serve as battlegrounds and financial power rules every transaction.

ld.articleBody:
Phulera Returns Delayed

Audiences awaiting a return to the fictional village of Phulera before the end of the year will have to exercise patience. Prime Video has confirmed that the much-anticipated fifth installment of the acclaimed series will not premiere as previously anticipated, pushing the timeline well into 2027.

Rumors and early speculation had pointed toward a potential late-year rollout. However, the streaming network poured cold water on those expectations, making it official that fans will need to wait longer to catch up with their favorite rural comedy-drama.

Banrakas Breaks the News

To deliver the disappointing update, the production team turned to the show's most notorious troublemakers. A clever social media campaign featured actor Durgesh Kumar reprising his role as Bhushan Sharma, widely known as Banrakas.

The promotional rollout began with a stark message informing viewers that the upcoming chapter would not arrive this year. The accompanying visual featured a smug-looking Banrakas with folded hands, signaling that the village rivals are holding the release hostage.

Kranti Devi's Bizarre Ransom

The playful campaign continued with a second promotional video starring Sunita Rajwar as Kranti Devi. Fresh off her recent electoral victory, the character flexed her newfound authority and demanded proper respect from the community.

Leaning into the humorous ransom angle, the promo urged impatient fans to visit a specific portal and place a costly garland worth Rs 1 crore around Banrakas to secure the release of the upcoming episodes.

Looking Back at Season 4

The upcoming fifth installment follows a dramatic preceding season that left audiences divided. The previous narrative arc featured significant political upheaval, notably when Kranti Devi successfully unseated Manju Devi in the village elections.

Beyond local politics, the fourth season also tackled major personal milestones. Viewers watched as Abhishek Tripathi finally cleared his CAT exam and navigated his growing feelings for Rinki.

Expected Cast Returns

While a precise premiere date for 2027 has not yet been announced, the core ensemble is expected to reprise their beloved roles. The creative universe of Phulera relies heavily on its familiar faces to drive the narrative forward.

Fans can look forward to seeing Jitendra Kumar, Neena Gupta, Raghubir Yadav, and Sanvikaa back in action alongside Faisal Malik and Chandan Roy as the village chaos resumes.

Marketing Engine Warms Up

Although the delay comes as a disappointment to eager followers, the interactive rollout demonstrates that promotional efforts are officially underway. By leaning into fan-favorite antagonist dynamics, the marketing team has successfully sustained viewer interest.

The cheeky teasers have kept social media engaged despite the extended timeline, proving that the rural inhabitants of Phulera remain a massive draw for streaming audiences.

Introduction to the Heroes of Hyrule Line

Hasbro has officially announced a new wave of physical merchandise for fans of Nintendo's iconic franchise with The Legend of Zelda: Heroes of Hyrule collection.

These upcoming figures draw their aesthetic and character designs directly from the massively popular game The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom.

Anniversary and Franchise Context

The franchise itself is celebrating forty years since its original debut as a pixelated adventure in the United States back in 1987.

Over the decades, the series has blended exploration, discovery, action, and puzzle-solving into an enduring staple of gaming culture.

The Link figure stands at a 15-centimeter scale and features over twenty points of articulation alongside a fabric soft goods cape.

Collectors can pose the hero using a Hylian shield, an interchangeable Zonai power hand, and the iconic Master Sword.

Princess Zelda matches Link's 15-centimeter scale and comes with the Decayed Master Sword and an interchangeable sword grip hand.

Both the Link and Princess Zelda action figures are priced at $27.99 each.

Paramount Network Orders New Series

Paramount Network has officially expanded its programming lineup by securing a brand-new series led by a well-known comedian. The network has issued an order for a set of original episodes that will bring quick-witted commentary and everyday humor directly to linear cable viewers.

This television pickup highlights the network's ongoing strategy to feature entertaining content that appeals to a wide audience. The project will serve as a prominent addition to their weekly schedule.

Format and Premiere Details

The newly ordered program is a half-hour clip series designed to showcase amusing and relatable situations from across the country. Scheduled to debut on a Friday evening, the project represents a fresh venture for the platform.

The initial batch consists of thirteen brand-new instalments created exclusively for this specific television network. Viewers can expect fast-paced entertainment highlighting ordinary mishaps and lighthearted moments.

Syndication and Separate Distribution

While the cable network is receiving its own dedicated run, the property also exists in a broader syndicated version. A separate distribution agreement has been established to bring a larger collection of episodes to television stations across multiple major markets.

Major metropolitan areas including New York, Los Angeles, and Chicago are included in the syndication rollout. This multi-platform approach allows the production to reach viewers through both local broadcast stations and cable networks.

Content and Logline

The premise of the program focuses on everyday life, capturing funny and unexpected occurrences from small towns and family gatherings. Content ranges from weekend do-it-yourself disasters and backyard slip-ups to pets stealing the spotlight.

The host relies on his distinctive perspective and heartland humor to guide the audience through these unpredictable situations. The tone is meant to celebrate the rough-and-tumble side of Americana with warmth and amusement.

Executive Perspectives

Network executives have expressed enthusiasm about the collaboration, pointing out the host's natural ability to connect with viewers. Leadership noted that the format reflects the unpredictable nature of daily life in an entertaining way.

Representatives from the production company echoed these sentiments, emphasizing that the star understands his audience deeply. They also highlighted the value of maintaining a strong working relationship with their partners.

Behind the Scenes

The series is backed by a team of executive producers working alongside the main host. Key production figures contributing to the project include Maggie Houlehan, Carter Skeath, Rick De Oliveira, Josh Vodnoy, and John Stevens.

Production responsibilities are handled by V10 Entertainment, which coordinated the multi-tiered distribution strategy for both the cable and syndicated versions of the show.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction to the Case

A judicial magistrate in Mumbai ordered the release of an individual who had been detained in the national capital in connection with the online distribution of manipulated nude photographs belonging to well-known actor Sonakshi Sinha. The actor had earlier approached local authorities to lodge a formal complaint against the digital harassment.

Law enforcement officials in Mumbai registered a formal case at the Bandra police station following the complaint. The grievance detailed how manipulated pictures of the celebrity were being circulated across various social media platforms by a suspect based in Delhi.

Detention and Transit

The suspect, identified in court records as Aryan Deepak Jain, was taken into custody by authorities from the Jagatpuri Police Station situated in the Shahdara district of Delhi. Following the apprehension, he was flown directly to Mumbai to be produced before a local magistrate.

Police officials sought a three-day custodial remand of the individual. The primary rationale provided by the investigating team was the necessity to track down the digital devices utilized in generating and spreading the offensive material.

Court Observers and Procedural Flaws

Upon reviewing the circumstances of the apprehension, the presiding magistrate noticed glaring omissions in the execution of standard legal protocols. Specifically, the authorities failed to produce the detained person before the nearest local magistrate in Delhi prior to interstate transit.

The court highlighted that the investigating agency could not provide a reasonable justification for bypassing this mandatory step. Direct transit from Delhi to Mumbai without local judicial clearance was deemed a clear violation of established legal requirements.

Arguments by the Defense Counsel

The legal representatives appearing for the accused—namely Aman Shahi, Prashant Trivedi, and Aditya Jain—vehemently contested the police remand plea. They pointed out that mandatory arrest notices were never served to their client, nor were the proper grounds of arrest clearly communicated.

Defense attorneys further emphasized that rushing the individual out of Delhi's jurisdiction by flight reflected an unusual haste, which they attributed to the high-profile nature of the celebrity complainant. The accused maintained his complete innocence throughout the proceedings.

Application of BNSS Safeguards

The magistrate examined the statutory provisions governing the offences invoked, which carried potential prison terms of up to seven years. Because of this threshold, compliance with Section 35(1)(b) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) was strictly required.

The court observed that the official records lacked any satisfactory documentation demonstrating the necessity of the arrest or compliance with the specified recording procedures mandated by the statute.

Significance of Statutory Compliance

In its final observations, the judiciary underscored that the mere requirement of carrying out further investigation cannot override the absolute necessity of adhering to established legal safeguards during an arrest.

The bench reiterated that detention without following due process remains legally unsustainable, regardless of the investigative goals or the gravity of the allegations raised by the complainant.

The magistrate flagged multiple violations of legal procedures and BNSS safeguards, noting that the police failed to produce the accused before a local magistrate in Delhi before bringing him to Mumbai.

ld.articleBody:
Mike Myers Discusses the Shrek Franchise Future

Actor Mike Myers has indicated that his journey with the iconic Shrek franchise may extend well beyond the upcoming fifth installment. Following his preparation to reprise his famous role as the title ogre in Shrek 5 next summer, Myers shared fresh insights during a recent discussion.

In an interview with The Hollywood Reporter, the actor spoke warmly about returning to the beloved character. He highlighted the strength of the films' writing, praised the creative team behind the scenes, and commended the enduring positive messages delivered by the series.

Praise for Co-Stars and Donkey's Standalone Film

During the interview, Myers made it clear that he remains deeply enthusiastic about being a part of the franchise's ongoing expansion. He specifically praised his fellow cast members Cameron Diaz and Eddie Murphy, celebrating their collaborative efforts.

The franchise is actively growing beyond the fifth film with the development of a standalone Donkey movie. Myers revealed his happiness for Murphy, calling Donkey one of his favorite characters and noting that he considers the spinoff long overdue.

Potential Role in the Donkey Prequel

The upcoming Donkey movie is structured as a prequel designed to explore the character's origin story. Because the narrative unfolds before Donkey ever crosses paths with Shrek, the probability of Myers having a major presence in the film remains relatively low.

Even so, the actor has not completely ruled out making an appearance. Myers stated that while he is uncertain of his direct involvement, he would gladly participate if given the opportunity.

Support for Eddie Murphy's Performance

Myers offered high praise for Eddie Murphy's comedic work throughout the franchise, describing his performance as that of a genius. The profound appreciation for his co-star's talent reinforces the strong bond shared by the main cast members over the years.

Demonstrating his ongoing support, Myers confirmed that he intends to be among the very first people in line to experience the film in theaters when it finally arrives.

Upcoming Release Timeline for the Franchise

Audiences can look forward to multiple projects arriving over the next few years. Shrek 5 is scheduled for release on June 30, 2027, bringing back Shrek, Donkey, and Princess Fiona for a brand new adventure.

Following that release, the standalone Donkey movie is slated to hit theaters on June 30, 2028, continuing the expansion of the beloved animated universe.

Cast Details for Shrek 5

The upcoming fifth film will introduce significant changes to the central family dynamic. The sequel is set to feature older versions of the three children belonging to Shrek and Fiona.

The younger generation of characters will be voiced by a newly announced cast, including Zendaya as Felicia, Skyler Gisondo as Farkle, and Marcello Hernández as Fergus.

Alongside his enthusiasm for Eddie Murphy's character, Myers continues his work on Shrek 5, which arrives in June 2027 ahead of the Donkey spinoff in June 2028.

ld.articleBody:
Celebrating a Silver Milestone

In honor of the upcoming 25th anniversary of Karan Johar's monumental film Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham, Airbnb is bringing one of the most famous fictional residences in Bollywood history into the physical world. The platform has carefully recreated the lavish Raichand family mansion for an exclusive, limited-time activation situated in Mumbai.

This unique initiative allows dedicated admirers of the 2001 classic to step straight into the cinematic universe of the film. Visitors can explore meticulously designed replicas of iconic areas from the motion picture, offering a nostalgic journey through a cornerstone of Indian cinema.

Inside the Raichand Residence Experience

Titled 'At Home with the Raichands,' the special two-hour experience gives attendees the chance to wander through memorable zones of the sprawling estate. Guests can walk up the grand staircase, explore the family study, and tour an extravagant closet dedicated to the fashion of the character Poo.

In addition to walking the halls, visitors will be guided by an immersive audio tour highlighting unforgettable moments from the movie. Attendees can also participate in a character-inspired entry challenge and leave behind a personal note centered on the film's core themes of family and love, receiving a special commemorative keepsake at the end.

Star-Studded Presentation and Hosting

While the three stars attached to the presentation will not be present in person, the activation is proudly presented by filmmaker Karan Johar alongside actors Kareena Kapoor Khan and Hrithik Roshan. Both actors played pivotal roles in the original picture, portraying Rohan Raichand and the fashion-forward Poo, respectively.

The collaboration brings an authentic touch to the fan event, leveraging the enduring popularity of the characters. Both actors shared their enthusiasm for the project, noting how wonderful it is to see the film continue to resonate deeply with a brand new generation of viewers a quarter-century later.

Background of a Defining Bollywood Drama

Released in December 2001 and frequently referred to as K3G, the movie featured a massive ensemble cast that included cinematic legends Amitabh Bachchan and Jaya Bachchan, alongside superstar Shah Rukh Khan and Kajol. The plot centered around a wealthy Indian family torn apart after a son marries against the wishes of his strict father.

The family drama quickly cemented itself as a defining cultural touchstone of its era. Its grand production design, memorable musical numbers, and distinct fashion choices continue to influence and entertain younger audiences long after its initial theatrical run.

Booking Details and Availability

Space for the immersive experience is extremely limited, with just 180 total guest spots available across the duration of the event. The activation will officially run from December 1 through December 6 in Mumbai.

Booking requests are scheduled to open on November 23 at 12 p.m. IST via Airbnb's dedicated K3G page. While the experience itself is free and covers up to two guests per booking, visitors are responsible for arranging and funding their own travel to Mumbai.

Entertainment and Fan Culture on Airbnb

This special event forms a part of Airbnb's ongoing 'Only on Airbnb' program. The initiative increasingly leans into popular entertainment properties and broader fan culture to transform fictional settings into tangible, real-world experiences.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction to the Mythological Project

The ambitious cinematic adaptation of Ramayana, directed by filmmaker Nitesh Tiwari, has emerged as one of the most talked-about ventures in contemporary Bollywood. Built on an extraordinary budget of Rs 2000 crore, the mythological drama has generated immense online curiosity and widespread public discussion.

Featuring a massive ensemble cast including Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, Sai Pallavi, Ravi Dubey, Lara Dutta, Arun Govil, Rakul Preet Singh, and Vivek Oberoi, the high-profile project has captured the attention of audiences worldwide through its sheer scale and heavy reliance on visual effects.

Critical Reception and Visual Effects

Upon its theatrical release, the big-budget epic opened to mixed reviews from both critics and regular moviegoers. While the visual effects have drawn considerable praise and captured eyeballs across digital platforms, the film's tone has sparked intense debate among viewers.

Many audience members and analysts have voiced opinions that the narrative lacks a deep sense of traditional devotion, leading to varied reactions regarding how the sacred epic was translated onto the silver screen.

Reactions from Industry Veterans

The film also caught the attention of veterans from past television adaptations, including Sunil Lahri, who famously portrayed Lakshman in Ramanand Sagar's classic series Ramayan. Lahri shared his critique after watching the new film, calling it a mixed experience.

He specifically pointed out that divinity and devotion were missing from the production, noting that several crucial scenes were omitted. Furthermore, he expressed concern that the dialogue lacked necessary dignity and felt the character of Ravana was excessively glorified.

Global Box Office Performance

Despite mixed critical feedback, the mythological drama has proven to be an unstoppable force during its second weekend at the worldwide box office. By the end of its tenth day in theaters, the cumulative global collection reached an impressive Rs 1228 crore.

The massive international numbers reflect strong audience turnout overseas, where the film pulled in significant figures despite competing against other major blockbusters currently running in cinemas.

Overseas Collections Breakdown

According to reports from Sacnilk, the overseas market alone contributed Rs 30 crore on the tenth day, pushing the overall international earnings to a notable Rs 408.5 crore.

The day-wise overseas trajectory showed steady numbers, starting with Rs 51.25 crore on day one, Rs 46 crore on day two, and peaking at Rs 71.75 crore on day three before stabilizing through the weekdays and picking up momentum again in the second weekend.

Comparison with Competitors

While crossing the Rs 1200 crore mark globally in just ten days is a massive achievement, the feature fell slightly short of outpacing Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar 2.

Specifically, Dhurandhar 2 had previously managed a higher ten-day worldwide total of Rs 1255.41 crore, leaving Ramayana just behind that specific benchmark in the race for global supremacy.

Domestic Earnings Overview

On the home turf, the film raked in Rs 72.9 crore domestically on its tenth reporting period, contributing to a massive domestic haul. This included strong language-wise performances led by the Hindi version at Rs 53.75 crore, alongside contributions from Kannada at Rs 5.4 crore, Malayalam at Rs 4.75 crore, Tamil at Rs 4.75 crore, and Telugu at Rs 4.25 crore.

These regional figures propelled the overall domestic tally to Rs 685.6 crore in nett collections and a staggering Rs 819.5 crore in gross domestic earnings.

While it missed surpassing Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar 2 over the same ten-day window, the Ranbir Kapoor starrer remains a major box-office contender.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction to Pokémon FullDex

Classic entries in the Pokémon franchise continue to retain massive popularity among gamers around the world. Titles released during the Nintendo DS and 3DS eras are widely regarded as some of the finest installments in the entire series. Fans have long revisited these adventures, a habit further enabled by modern PC emulation and technological advancements.

However, playing dual-screen titles on single-monitor computer setups has historically presented layout challenges. A newly released software utility completely resolves this display hurdle, providing a smooth single-screen adaptation for classic monster-catching adventures.

How the Single-Screen Conversion Works

First highlighted by Retro Dodo, a public utility named Pokémon FullDex has been launched for players. Developed by creator mamesj, the software is available as a free download via GitHub. It successfully translates dual-screen Nintendo DS experiences into a unified 60 frames-per-second widescreen presentation.

The software works across a wide variety of hardware platforms, including Windows and Linux PCs, Mac computers, Steam Deck devices, handheld gaming PCs, Android phones, iPhones, iPads, and modded Nintendo Switch units. It allows up to 4K resolution on PC and 720p on the Switch, eliminating the need to squint at stacked handheld screens.

Supported Games and Platforms

The FullDex utility extends far beyond just Pokémon Black and White. The current compatibility list encompasses multiple generations of handheld classics. For Nintendo DS, supported titles include Black 2, White 2, Black, White, HeartGold, SoulSilver, Platinum, Diamond, and Pearl.

Additionally, Game Boy Advance titles like Emerald, Ruby, Sapphire, FireRed, LeafGreen, and Ultra Violet are supported. Early beta support for Nintendo 3DS games such as Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire is currently available on Windows, Android, and Switch, with X, Y, Ultra Sun, and Ultra Moon slated for future release.

Features and Technical Reception

The lightweight software package arrives equipped with several modern conveniences. Players can utilize built-in support for RetroAchievements alongside traditional cheat functionality. Demonstration videos showcasing the tech running live have impressed observers with how naturally the classic games adapt to the new aspect ratio.

Despite the technical praise, the project has attracted some discussion regarding its creation. The software was heavily assisted by Claude AI, introducing potential moral debates for gamers concerned about artificial intelligence integration within the gaming space.

Wider Franchise Context

This software release arrives as the overarching franchise moves past its milestone 30th anniversary celebrations. With those major festivities having largely concluded, the community anticipates a quieter period for official announcements in the immediate future.

Attention among fans is now shifting toward the horizon. The upcoming tenth-generation titles, Winds and Waves, represent the next major milestone for the series, with further updates anticipated during the first half of next year.

While praised for solving hardware display issues and adding features like RetroAchievements, the tool has sparked discussion due to its reliance on Claude AI development assistance. Meanwhile, the franchise looks ahead to future releases following the close of its 30th anniversary events.

Exclusive Trailer Premiere

ComingSoon has exclusively debuted the official trailer for Money by Sundown, a brand-new dark comedy centered around a chaotic kidnapping. The project comes from One Tree Entertainment and arrives ahead of its upcoming Digital release later this month.

Plot and Premise

The story follows a stressful situation where a teenage daughter is abducted and the ransom demands are completely impossible to pay. With few options remaining, the mother must turn to her lying, cheating ex-husband whom she hoped never to rely on again.

Character Tripp Holliday is described as charismatic, reckless, and always convinced he has a plan, making him the absolute last person Jessamine Holliday wants to call. However, with kidnappers demanding $80,000 by sundown, sheer desperation leaves no room for pride.

Tone and Setting

Every new solution creates an even bigger problem for the pair as they navigate a wild mix of suspense, dark comedy, and deep family dysfunction. The narrative proves that the people who drive us crazy can occasionally be the ones we need the most.

Festival Debut

Before hitting digital storefronts, the Southern dark comedy movie is scheduled to make its official world premiere at the Rome International Film Festival. The screening will take place in Rome, Georgia, on Saturday, November 7 at noon.

Cast and Crew

The dark comedy features performances by Claire Bronson, known for Mr Mercedes, Bandit, and Greenland, alongside Burgess Jenkins, known for Blue Ridge: The Series, The Girl Who Believed in Miracles, The Young the Restless, and One Tree Hill.

The film is written and directed by filmmaker Geoffrey Gunn. The supporting cast includes Chapel Oaks, Matt Servitto, and Brian Ashton Smith.

Director Vision

Director Geoffrey Gunn explained that having lived and worked in the South for over a decade, he wanted to capture the real place he knew instead of the typical parodies seen on screen.

He also aimed to tell a fun story about larger-than-life schemers and dreamers, noting that the end result resembles a tall tale, keeping with the tradition of good Southern stories.

Release Details

Money by Sundown will officially become available to rent and purchase on Digital platforms on November 17, 2026.

Saturday Box Office Surge

The theatrical run of the mythological drama experienced a powerful resurgence on Saturday, November 7, following a brief collection dip on its second day. According to live estimates provided by Sacnilk, the feature brought in a net collection of Rs 69.80 crore across the country on Day 3.

This performance represents a substantial 45.3 percent increase compared to the earnings recorded on Friday. With these latest numbers, the film is now on the verge of entering the coveted Rs 200-crore domestic net club.

First Three Days Domestic Breakdown

The cinematic release started its theatrical journey on Thursday, November 5, with an opening domestic net total of Rs 64.85 crore. Collections experienced a decline on Friday, dropping to Rs 48.05 crore before bouncing back significantly with Saturday's figures.

Across the country, the feature was screened across 23,647 shows on Saturday, achieving an average earning of Rs 29,517 per show. The cumulative three-year domestic net collection has now reached Rs 182.70 crore, alongside a domestic gross total of Rs 218.25 crore.

Performance Across Language Versions

The Hindi version continued to dominate the domestic market, contributing 19,882 shows and securing a collection of Rs 53 crore on Saturday. Regional language versions also added meaningful numbers to the overall domestic tally.

The Kannada version generated Rs 6.30 crore from 907 shows, while the Telugu version brought in Rs 6 crore across 1,586 shows. Additionally, the Tamil version secured Rs 2.50 crore from 681 shows, and the Malayalam version contributed Rs 2 crore from 591 shows.

Global And Overseas Tally

Beyond domestic borders, the feature also performed strongly in international markets, adding substantial figures to its overall box office statistics. Overseas collections on Day 3 alone reached approximately Rs 60 crore.

This international performance pushed the cumulative overseas gross to an estimated Rs 157.25 crore. Combined with domestic revenues, the worldwide gross collection after three days stands at an impressive Rs 375.50 crore.

Comparison With Dhurandhar

The theatrical run has drawn industry comparisons with another strong box-office performer, Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar. Having amassed Rs 182.70 crore in India net collections within three days, the mythological adaptation has moved well ahead of Dhurandhar's reported opening-day figures of around Rs 28 crore.

Analysts note, however, that both releases operated under different conditions, and a three-day comparison differs significantly from evaluating lifetime theatrical performance.

Cast And Production Background

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana: Part One is a two-part adaptation based on the ancient epic. The narrative chronicles the journey of Rama, the abduction of Sita by Ravana, and the subsequent events leading to the battle between them.

The ensemble cast features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The project is produced by Namit Malhotra through Prime Focus Studios, in association with DNEG and Yash's Monster Mind Creations, with the second part scheduled for a Diwali 2028 release.

Nitesh Tiwari's mythological epic Ramayana: Part One saw a major 45.3 percent surge on Saturday, November 7, pushing its three-day India net total to Rs 182.70 crore and worldwide gross to Rs 375.50 crore. Featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi, the film is now poised to enter the Rs 200-crore domestic club.

Ramayana Box Office Collection Day 3: Ranbir Kapoor And Yash Starrer Sees Massive Saturday Jump

Nitesh Tiwari's mythological epic experiences a major 45.3 percent surge on its third day, bringing the domestic net collection to Rs 182.70 crore and closing in on the Rs 200-crore milestone.

Published 7 November 2026

Saturday Box Office Surge

The theatrical run of the mythological drama experienced a powerful resurgence on Saturday, November 7, following a brief collection dip on its second day. According to live estimates provided by Sacnilk, the feature brought in a net collection of Rs 69.80 crore across the country on Day 3.

This performance represents a substantial 45.3 percent increase compared to the earnings recorded on Friday. With these latest numbers, the film is now on the verge of entering the coveted Rs 200-crore domestic net club.

First Three Days Domestic Breakdown

The cinematic release started its theatrical journey on Thursday, November 5, with an opening domestic net total of Rs 64.85 crore. Collections experienced a decline on Friday, dropping to Rs 48.05 crore before bouncing back significantly with Saturday's figures.

Across the country, the feature was screened across 23,647 shows on Saturday, achieving an average earning of Rs 29,517 per show. The cumulative three-year domestic net collection has now reached Rs 182.70 crore, alongside a domestic gross total of Rs 218.25 crore.

Performance Across Language Versions

The Hindi version continued to dominate the domestic market, contributing 19,882 shows and securing a collection of Rs 53 crore on Saturday. Regional language versions also added meaningful numbers to the overall domestic tally.

The Kannada version generated Rs 6.30 crore from 907 shows, while the Telugu version brought in Rs 6 crore across 1,586 shows. Additionally, the Tamil version secured Rs 2.50 crore from 681 shows, and the Malayalam version contributed Rs 2 crore from 591 shows.

Global And Overseas Tally

Beyond domestic borders, the feature also performed strongly in international markets, adding substantial figures to its overall box office statistics. Overseas collections on Day 3 alone reached approximately Rs 60 crore.

This international performance pushed the cumulative overseas gross to an estimated Rs 157.25 crore. Combined with domestic revenues, the worldwide gross collection after three days stands at an impressive Rs 375.50 crore.

Comparison With Dhurandhar

The theatrical run has drawn industry comparisons with another strong box-office performer, Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar. Having amassed Rs 182.70 crore in India net collections within three days, the mythological adaptation has moved well ahead of Dhurandhar's reported opening-day figures of around Rs 28 crore.

Analysts note, however, that both releases operated under different conditions, and a three-day comparison differs significantly from evaluating lifetime theatrical performance.

Cast And Production Background

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana: Part One is a two-part adaptation based on the ancient epic. The narrative chronicles the journey of Rama, the abduction of Sita by Ravana, and the subsequent events leading to the battle between them.

The ensemble cast features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The project is produced by Namit Malhotra through Prime Focus Studios, in association with DNEG and Yash's Monster Mind Creations, with the second part scheduled for a Diwali 2028 release.

Featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi, the film is now poised to enter the Rs 200-crore domestic club.

Star-Studded Cast and Crew

Beyond its lead trio of Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash, the film boasts a massive ensemble cast. Notable names such as Ravie Dubey, Sunny Deol, Rakul Preet Singh, Arun Govil, Adinath Kothare, Lara Dutta, Vivek Oberoi, and Sheeba Chadha contribute to the project's grand scale.

On the administrative and creative front, the project is co-produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash. As one of the most heavily anticipated and expensive releases of 2026, it generated substantial buzz long before its actual theatrical debut.

Pre-Release Records and Momentum

Even before lighting up theater screens around the world, Ramayana was busy rewriting record books. The feature secured the second-highest advance booking collection in recent times while simultaneously delivering the highest opening for lead star Ranbir Kapoor.

Furthermore, its opening weekend figures ranked among the highest ever recorded. This immense early momentum set the stage for sustained box office dominance as the theatrical run entered its first weekdays.

Day 5 Worldwide Milestones

Overseas Performance and Earnings

International markets have played a vital role in fueling the film's financial triumph. By the conclusion of its fifth day in theaters, the cumulative overseas collection alone touched an impressive Rs 250 crore.

This steady influx of international revenue combined with robust domestic numbers to cement the title's status as a global box office juggernaut.

Record-Breaking First Monday Numbers

The feature pulled in a massive Rs 107.5 crore on that single day alone, outperforming major box office heavyweights like Dhurandhar 2 and Pushpa 2 in first Monday collections in India.

This exceptional single-day surge brought the overall nett collection in India to Rs 346.35 crore, while gross domestic collections stood at Rs 413.9 crore.

Language-Wise Breakdown

The phenomenal day 5 earnings of Rs 107.5 crore came from a diverse multi-language distribution network across the country. The Hindi version led the charge by bringing in Rs 87.25 crore.

Regional markets also contributed significantly to the daily tally, with the Kannada version earning Rs 7.5 crore, the Telugu version adding Rs 6 crore, the Tamil version contributing Rs 4 crore, and the Malayalam version chipping in with Rs 2.75 crore.

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and starring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash, the mythological drama Ramayana has crossed the Rs 600 crore mark globally to reach Rs 663.9 crore after five days in theaters. Powered by a record-breaking first Monday collection of Rs 107.5 crore in India and an overseas total of Rs 250 crore, the high-budget co-production has cemented its place in box office history.

Introduction To The Preview Success

The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping has made a stellar entrance at the North American box office. Powered by immense anticipation from fans, the movie secured an impressive opening through early ticket sales.

This initial triumph sets a strong foundation for the film's theatrical run. Industry analysts have closely tracked these numbers as a primary indicator of the franchise's enduring popularity.

Breakdown Of The Preview Earnings

According to the latest reports, the feature pulled in a solid $21 million from combined Wednesday and Thursday previews across North America. This robust figure highlights the heavy demand for tickets prior to the official weekend launch.

Such a strong start places the film in an elite category of early earners for the year. The preview figures surpassed initial expectations set by industry trackers.

Surpassing 2026 Competitors

The preview haul successfully outpaced several prominent contenders in the market. Notably, it bypassed the preview collections of other 2026 blockbusters like The Odyssey and Michael.

By beating these rivals, the film locked in the second-biggest preview haul of 2026. It now sits just behind Spider-Man: Brand New Day in that specific yearly ranking.

Milestones For The Studio And Franchise

For Lionsgate, this preview performance marks a significant company milestone. It stands as the studio's largest preview haul since The Hunger Games: Catching Fire achieved $25 million back in 2013.

Furthermore, the earnings dwarf those of its predecessor. The collection is almost four times greater than the $5.8 million preview earned by The Hunger Games: Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes.

All-Time And Seasonal Rankings

Beyond current-year comparisons, the movie carved out space in all-time record lists. It topped the preview hauls of Suicide Squad and Captain Marvel to secure the thirty-second spot for all-time preview earnings in North America.

In the category of November releases, it registered the seventh-biggest preview haul ever. It outperformed Wicked, which previously held a lower preview figure of $19.2 million.

Opening Weekend Projections

Current box office tracking points toward a massive three-day opening weekend. Projections indicate the film is on track to earn between $100 million and $120 million domestically.

Hitting this projected range would make it the fifth movie in 2026 to cross the $100 million opening mark. The film was released on November 20 under the direction of Francis Lawrence.

Cast And Production Context

The film features performances from Joseph Zada and Mckenna Grace in leading roles. Their involvement has been central to the marketing and audience draw for this chapter of the dystopian series.

Director Francis Lawrence helmed the project, bringing further continuity to the cinematic universe. Estimates and various sources continue to provide updates as the full weekend figures develop.

Directed by Francis Lawrence and starring Joseph Zada and Mckenna Grace, the film surpassed competitors like The Odyssey and Michael while setting a new high for Lionsgate.

The AI Odyssey Release

Tech billionaire Elon Musk has taken a step toward fulfilling his ambitious pledge to adapt Homer's classic epic using artificial intelligence. His platform shared the initial 7-minute episode of an AI-generated series based on The Odyssey.

Grok Imagine Tool

The release follows a previous 3-minute short that was shared on the social media platform earlier in the year. The latest project utilizes the Grok Imagine tool to bring the ancient Greek text to life in a video format.

Creative Collaboration

While the initiative stems from Musk's artificial intelligence tools, the recent release credited specific external entities for the creative collaboration. Wonder Studios and director Dev Walker were recognized for their involvement in the AI filmmaking process.

Both collaborating names specialize in the emerging field of artificial intelligence filmmaking, helping shape the visual output delivered in this initial episodic release on the X platform.

Musk's Original Pledge

In July, Elon Musk first announced plans to produce a full-length feature version of the ancient Greek poem. He claimed at the time that the resulting project would remain historically accurate and true to the art of Homer.

Timeline for the Project

The tech mogul initially set a timeline indicating that the AI-driven adaptation would be ready before the end of 2026, sparking widespread discussion across the entertainment and technology sectors.

Hollywood Backlash

The announcement of an AI-driven classical adaptation drew sharp criticism from established Hollywood filmmakers. Director Scott Derrickson publicly dismissed the project and criticized Musk's understanding of cinema on social media.

Derrickson pulled no punches in his online response, arguing that the billionaire's opinions on art held no value and claiming he stopped reading books in his youth.

Criticism of Traditional Films

Musk's venture into AI filmmaking has frequently coincided with his vocal criticisms of traditional Hollywood productions. He previously took aim at another project's casting choices, specifically targeting actors Elliot Page and Lupita Nyong'o.

The tech entrepreneur alleged that those casting decisions were made solely to satisfy academy representation and inclusion standards for award eligibility, lobbing accusations at the film's director.

Netflix And The Thriller Genre

Netflix has long established itself as a primary destination for thriller enthusiasts, building a vast library that ranges from psychological dramas to legal procedurals. Over the years, the streaming platform has capitalized on the binge-release model by offering suspenseful content that keeps subscribers hooked from start to finish. From foundational political dramas like House of Cards to contemporary hits such as The Lincoln Lawyer, You, His Hers, and I Will Find You, the thriller format has consistently driven massive viewership and dominated the service's charts.

Within this expansive catalog, spy thrillers have carved out a particularly successful niche. As audiences increasingly gravitate toward high-stakes espionage and covert operations, Netflix has curated a roster of gripping genre entries. Among these, a specific 2018 miniseries continues to stand out for its near-perfect critical reception and intense narrative delivery, proving that shorter, focused storytelling can outshine multi-season runs.

The Premise And Production Background

Originally broadcast on BBC One in the United Kingdom before securing international distribution as a Netflix Original, Bodyguard is a taut six-episode thriller created and written by Jed Mercurio. The series was directed by John Strickland and Thomas Vincent, bringing a gritty and realistic texture to the British television landscape. Its compact format allows for a tightly wound narrative that avoids the quality dips often associated with longer-running television properties.

The story centers on David Budd, an Afghanistan war veteran who transitions to a role as a Principal Protection Officer. Tasked with guarding high-profile politician Julia Montague, Budd finds himself trapped in a web of shifting loyalties, psychological turmoil, and a sprawling government conspiracy. The juxtaposition of his military background with the rigid demands of VIP protection creates an immediate tension that drives the narrative forward.

Richard Madden's Standout Performance

Much of the series' success rests on the shoulders of lead actor Richard Madden, whose magnetic portrayal of David Budd anchors the entire production. Madden communicates his character's internal struggles through subtle microexpressions, precise body language, and a palpable intensity that lets viewers share in his psychological state. His depiction of post-traumatic stress disorder cuts through the formalities of his assigned duties, making Budd a profoundly layered protagonist.

Madden's tour-de-force performance earned widespread acclaim, culminating in a Best Actor in a Television Series Drama win at the 2018 Golden Globe Awards. His chemistry with co-star Keeley Hawes, who portrays the polarizing politician Julia Montague, elevates the dramatic weight of every scene they share, turning verbal confrontations into high-stakes psychological chess matches.

High Stakes And Memorable Set Pieces

Unlike globetrotting adventures that rely primarily on international locales and endless gadgetry, Bodyguard focuses heavily on psychological tension while still delivering explosive set pieces. The series wastes no time establishing its high stakes, opening with a harrowing sequence in which Budd expertly de-escalates a potential suicide bombing on a train. This early moment sets a standard for suspense that persists throughout the run.

The narrative is punctuated by game-shifting developments, particularly around the midpoint of the season, which completely alters the direction of the plot. These dramatic pivots ensure that audiences remain guessing, blending quiet conversations about political power dynamics with sudden bursts of life-or-death peril.

Critical Reception And Rotten Tomatoes Acclaim

When stacked against other offerings on the platform, Bodyguard holds a distinct position of prestige. While Netflix features several popular spy titles such as The Night Agent, Unfamiliar, Black Doves, and The Recruit, the 2018 miniseries outpaces many of them with an exceptional 93% critics' score on Rotten Tomatoes.

Beyond its score with critics, the show also made waves during the major awards season. In 2019, it received notable recognition at the Primetime Emmy Awards, earning nominations in competitive categories including Outstanding Drama Series and Outstanding Writing for a Drama Series.

The Surprising Public Attention

Wendi McLendon-Covey recently shared her astonishment regarding the heavy media attention she received after missing the 2026 Academy Awards. The actress had to skip the ceremony, which meant she missed out on a major reunion with her former costars.

While speaking on the set of Celebrity Weakest Link, the comedian noted that she never expected anyone to care about her absence. She found the entire situation to be quite odd yet humorous.

Explaining the Absence on Social Media

The reason behind her absence from the awards show was a cosmetic procedure. McLendon-Covey took to Instagram to address fans who were asking about her whereabouts after seeing her former castmates on stage.

Sharing a selfie with her head covered in bandages, she candidly explained that she had undergone a neck lift because she was tired of looking like a melting candle. She reassured her followers that everything was fine and there was no drama.

The 2026 Oscars ceremony took place on Sunday, March 15, at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood, hosted by Conan O'Brien. Hollywood stars gathered at the venue to celebrate the best in cinema during a heavily anticipated night.

During the event, several stars from the comedy hit Bridesmaids reunited to celebrate 15 years since the movie first hit theaters. The original film was directed by Paul Feig and became a massive box office success.

Future Possibilities for the Cast

Despite missing the recent on-stage gathering, McLendon-Covey has not ruled out the possibility of another reunion in the future. She noted that life is long and nobody knows what might happen down the road.

She also mentioned that her former costars are currently very busy with work commitments, pointing out that two of them are currently performing on Broadway.

Appearance on Celebrity Weakest Link

McLendon-Covey is currently focusing on her appearance on the game show Celebrity Weakest Link. She joined fellow comedians such as Nicole Byer, Heather McMahan, Mary Lynn Rajskub, Sasheer Zamata, Zarna Garg, Judy Gold, and Ms. Pat for a special Ladies Who Laugh episode.

Reflecting on her journey into comedy, she recalled watching performers as a young girl and aspiring to make people feel happy. She noted that it took a long time to reach this point in her career.

Potential Themed Episodes

During her time discussing the game show, the actress floated fun ideas for potential future episodes. She suggested that a Bridesmaids-themed episode could be a fun concept for the television program.

She also joked about other potential matchups for the show, drawing inspiration from past episodes she had watched where TV doctors competed against real doctors.

ld.articleBody:
North American Advance Booking Surge

The advance-booking phase for Namit Malhotra's Ramayana: Part One in North America has reached a pivotal juncture. The mythological epic is currently closing in on the final major ticket sales benchmark for its US premiere.

Sales have crossed 51,000 tickets for the upcoming paid previews scheduled for November 4. This momentum puts the movie just under 1,000 tickets away from matching the benchmark set by Dhurandhar 2.

Leaving Previous Blockbusters Behind

In the lead-up to this milestone, the production steadily outpaced the estimated premiere ticket sales of several major Indian blockbusters. Previous reference points cleared by the film include Animal, Jawan, Pushpa 2, and Pathaan.

The upward trajectory also saw the title move past the estimated premiere benchmarks associated with RRR, Baahubali 2, and Kalki 2898 AD over recent days.

Rapid Growth in Ticket Tally

The speed of the advance sales has caught the attention of industry trackers. Just a few days prior, on October 30, reports indicated the tally stood around 37,000 premiere tickets, having just surpassed RRR.

Within a span of three days, the total surged by nearly 40 percent. This dramatic increase propelled the film past both Baahubali 2 and Kalki 2898 AD benchmarks.

The Dhurandhar 2 Benchmark

Despite clearing seven major reference levels, the film faces its toughest remaining comparison in Dhurandhar 2. That Ranveer Singh blockbuster secured an extended North American opening of approximately $14 million.

Surpassing the ticket benchmark used for that film does not automatically guarantee breaking the actual opening gross record, but it places the project within striking distance of elite international debut figures.

Projections and Potential Openings

Current booking trends point toward an estimated five-day North American opening landing between $13 million and $14 million. Analysts note this is an indicative projection derived from early conversion patterns.

The ultimate success of these projections will depend on whether the feature can sustain its booking momentum past the initial preview screenings scheduled for Wednesday.

Distribution of Advance Sales

Data regarding the 1.40 lakh total tickets booked across the November 4 to November 8 opening period reveals distinct viewing patterns. Approximately 37 percent of these sales are concentrated strictly on preview night.

Combined figures for preview night and Thursday currently outweigh the entire Friday-to-Sunday weekend period, pointing to intense early demand among overseas audiences.

The Return of Peter Parker

Marvel Cinematic Universe fans may soon have another reason to head back to the local multiplex. Fresh reports indicate that Spider-Man: Brand New Day, starring Tom Holland in the title role, is preparing for a special theatrical re-release.

The superhero adventure originally debuted in cinemas on July 31, 2026. Directed by Destin Daniel Cretton, the film has continued to generate strong interest among comic book enthusiasts across the globe.

What to Expect From the Additional Footage

According to industry tracking sources, the upcoming re-release will include approximately 10 minutes of brand-new, unseen footage. This expanded cut aims to give audiences extra incentive to experience the blockbuster on the big screen once more.

While ticket-booking platforms briefly listed the special screenings before removing them, anticipation has already peaked among moviegoers hoping to catch the extended sequences.

Timing Ahead of Avengers: Doomsday

The rumored theatrical return is penciled in for December 4, 2026. This timing places the re-release just a couple of weeks prior to the arrival of the massive crossover event, Avengers: Doomsday.

With Avengers: Doomsday scheduled to land in theaters globally on December 18, 2026, and a day earlier on December 17 in India, the timing of the Spider-Man re-release aligns strategically with Marvel's broader cinematic rollout.

Plot Background and Narrative Arc

The storyline of Spider-Man: Brand New Day picks up in the aftermath of Doctor Strange's spell, which completely erased Peter Parker's existence from public memory. He continues defending New York City while remaining isolated from MJ and Ned.

Four years down the line, a sequence of coordinated attacks on Department of Damage Control facilities pulls Peter into a fresh investigation involving a mysterious element known as V-Max, alongside the emergence of strange, difficult-to-control abilities.

Key Characters and Alliances

During his pursuit of the truth behind the facility attacks, Peter crosses paths with Jean Grey, a young telepath dealing with a tragic link to the Department of Damage Control. Together, they navigate a dangerous conspiracy involving her powers and hidden government secrets.

Tom Holland is joined by a star-studded ensemble cast, featuring Zendaya, Sadie Sink, Jacob Batalon, Jon Bernthal, Florence Pugh, Marisa Tomei, and Mark Ruffalo in pivotal roles.

Broader Cinematic Universe Expansion

The Marvel Cinematic Universe continues to expand its sprawling narrative threads through these major theatrical milestones. Alongside the ongoing developments in the Spider-Man franchise, future projects like Avengers: Doomsday are building immense excitement.

Reports surrounding the upcoming ensemble film suggest major franchise returns, including Chris Evans coming back to the universe alongside Robert Downey Jr. stepping into the formidable role of Doctor Doom.

Reports indicate that Tom Holland's Spider-Man: Brand New Day will return to theaters on December 4 with ten minutes of additional footage. The re-release arrives shortly before the December premiere of Avengers: Doomsday.
